name: BuildContext::from_tar

test_list.description: Require a regular UTF-8 root Dockerfile and reject symlink entries.
Check cache mount ID/target against a RUN directive and require a supported frontend.
Reject missing cache declarations and external ADD URLs.

inputs.name: bytes
inputs.description: A bounded tar archive to pass to the Docker Engine build API.

output_description: A bounded archive with safe entries and captured UTF-8 Dockerfile content used for offline image/frontend/cache validation.
